title: Adieu aux ‘Enfants Rouges’: Tears and shock as fire destroys Paris’s oldest covered food market
summary: A devastating blaze destroyed the French capital’s oldest covered food market in the early hours of Monday, stripping Paris of a cherished venue popular with locals and tourists alike. Traders and residents said the destruction of the Enfants Rouges market, named after a 16th-century orphanage, had left them feeling “orphaned” themselves.
